lines: •2026 financial guidance raised to a total revenue range of $337 million to $351 million (previously between $278 million and $292 million) and an Adjusted EBITDA range of $176 million to $190 million (previously between $114 million and $128 million)

•The Company has increased its 2026 financial guidance for total revenue to be between $337 million and $351 million (previously between $278 million and $292 million) and adjusted EBITDA to be between $176 million and $190 million (previously between $114 million and $128 million), excluding the impact of any future transactions.
